name: High Divine
source:
Waking up in a dangerous, magical world with no memories, three alluring strangers will help you get your memories back. For a price...

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

在危机四伏的魔法世界醒来、失去了全部记忆的你，遇到了三位魅力惑人的陌生人。他们愿意帮你找回过往的记忆——但需要付出代价……
